panels.title: Implementation status · documented scope, not live health
panels.text:
Implementation status · documented scope, not live health
Capability	Current evidence boundary
Namespace intent / node inventory	Live CMTC telemetry above; Observe remains read-only
Workload mTLS / native DENY	Tested in the isolated two-node SPIRE fixture; see the separate mTLS evidence
Persistent strict admission / authorization	Missing-policy, first-packet, finer caller permissions and restart/revocation gates remain open
CA trust / rotation / remote identity	Public SVID validation demonstrated locally; rotation, issuer faults and cluster identity isolation remain open
ClusterMesh / WireGuard / IPsec	Observe ClusterMesh baseline tested; cross-cluster workload mTLS and transport composition remain unqualified

Missing security metrics are unknown. No invented handshake, protected-pod, trust-ready or transport-success numbers are substituted. Planned panels below retain every original domain; their metrics will be implemented as the agile stories progress.

Native authenticated-only trial — no application-port list

Native panels: isolated cmtc-mtls fixture only. The Cluster selector affects planned CMTC panels below. Planned panels: not implemented; No data is expected until their stories land.

Two nodes · no application sidecars · no CNP / CCNP / KNP. Native policy rejects an absent verified TLS principal, without an application-port list.

Passed: mTLS on 80 / 8080 / 9443 and Service 18080 → 8080; unenrolled and host clients received no HTTP response. Restart probes: 384 during ztunnel restart + 1,014 during Cilium restart, zero unexpected HTTP responses.

Open gates: missing-policy and first-packet admission, platform exceptions, cross-cluster and transport composition. Complete Protected status is not claimed.

panels.title: Scope and independent evidence

Scope and independent evidence

Measured on 2026-10-24: 6,000/6,000 HTTP 200 under mTLS load; 900/900 unenrolled attempts rejected. SPIRE outage: six structured retries, no false ACK, authenticated ACK after recovery.

Pins: agent f052d1276b, operator d8124529b5, host Podman / Linux ARM64; deployed image verified on both nodes. Public SVIDs, packet/TLS/canary checks, full commands and raw queries accompany the screenshot.

Native table: lifetime counters, not selected-range totals. unknown = no verified mesh principal; DENY = policy rejection; - = no failure flag. Remaining acceptance: issue #8.

panels.title: How to read the connection totals and percentages

How to read the connection totals and percentages

Selected range: the three totals are counter increases, estimated across resets. Attempts without verified mTLS include later DENY rejections; never add DENY to attempts.

Pie: one destination record per completed TCP attempt in this range; five exclusive outcomes total 100%. In-flight connections and early unrecorded failures are excluded. No failure flag does not prove HTTP success. TCP connections ≠ HTTP requests ≠ TLS handshakes.
